items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I worked with him at Kid Clayton, that band... We were way together. Yeah, we played a lot of picnics together and out here at Mama Lou's

ctx.x: Bass player? A good man, yeah. I worked with him at Kid Clayton, that band, that little band, Kid Clayton. We were way together. Yeah, we played a lot of picnics together and out here at Mama Lou's and he was running and we were out there. I was out there for years with Clayton and Eddie Dorsey. That's a good man. Good bass player. I'm surprised that Kenny had him out there. He's a good man, Eddie Dorsey.
